{"message":"I created the requested PowerShell script for monitoring active window titles and logging them continuously.

What I delivered
- Script path: /workspace/track.ps1
- Behavior:
  - Samples the foreground window every IntervalMs (default 1000 ms)
  - Logs only on state changes (Active window change or transition to Idle) for lightweight tracking
  - Detects user idle via system last-input time; logs an Idle record after IdleThresholdSec (default 300 s)
  - CSV output with header: timestamp,state,title,process_name,process_id
  - Default log file: <script folder>/active-window-log.csv

Notes
- This script uses Win32 APIs (user32.dll) and must run on Windows PowerShell or PowerShell 7 on Windows.

How to run
- Open PowerShell (Windows PowerShell or pwsh on Windows):
  - Example (default settings):
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\path\to\track.ps1"
  - Example (custom settings):
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\path\to\track.ps1" -IntervalMs 500 -IdleThresholdSec 120 -LogFile "$env:USERPROFILE\active-window-log.csv"
- View the log live:
  Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\active-window-log.csv" -Wait

Run in background
- PowerShell background job:
  Start-Job -ScriptBlock { & "C:\path\to\track.ps1" -IntervalMs 1000 -IdleThresholdSec 300 -LogFile "$env:USERPROFILE\active-window-log.csv" }

Stopping the script
- Press Ctrl+C in the session running the script, or stop the background job/scheduled task.

  - Detects user idle via system last-input time; logs an Idle record after IdleThresholdSec (default 300 s)
  - CSV output with header: timestamp,state,title,process_name,process_id

    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\path\to\track.ps1"
  - Example (custom settings):
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\path\to\track.ps1" -IntervalMs 500 -IdleThresholdSec 120 -LogFile "$env:USERPROFILE\active-window-log.csv"
- View the log live:
  Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\active-window-log.csv" -Wait

Run in background

  Start-Job -ScriptBlock { & "C:\path\to\track.ps1" -IntervalMs 1000 -IdleThresholdSec 300 -LogFile "$env:USERPROFILE\active-window-log.csv" }
